## About
E&N Towing and Auto Service is a full service auto maintenance and repair shop on East Main Street in Bridgewater. We handle the everyday work like tune-ups, oil changes, brakes and exhaust, and we specialize in engine and transmission rebuilding and installation.
We also run towing and roadside assistance for all of Somerset County. One customer told us she'd already waited hours on another company before she found us. Ray and the truck crew try to get to you quickly and handle your car with care.
Our technicians are ASE Certified and we use OEM parts, so your warranty stays intact. Neighbors have given us a 4.3 rating across 47 Google reviews, and Drew's name comes up more than once.

## Services
- Engine and Transmission Rebuilding and Installation: This is our specialty. We rebuild and install engines and transmissions right here in the shop.
- 24/7 Towing: Broken down after hours or on the weekend? We tow around the clock.
- Roadside assistance: Help on the roadside anywhere in Somerset County.
- Tune-ups: Routine tune-ups to keep your car running right.
- Oil change: Regular oil changes as part of your car's upkeep.
- Brakes: Brake inspection and repair.
- Exhaust: Exhaust system repair.
- Headlight repair: One customer said Drew made her headlight repair seamless and worked around her schedule.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get a tow outside of shop hours?
A: Yes. Towing runs around the clock, any day of the week.

Q: How far do you go for towing and roadside help?
A: We cover all of Somerset County.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes. We have a comfortable waiting room with WiFi, snacks and a TV.

Q: Will a repair here affect my warranty?
A: We use OEM parts, so you can rest assured your warranty will remain intact.
